measureRecords.whatItDoes: Borrow up to $6 million through general obligation bonds or notes to build a new town highway garage. Repayment would come from the town’s general fund, funded by real property taxes, over no more than 30 years. Available grants or other funding would reduce the borrowing.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the described borrowing of up to $6 million, with the stated repayment and funding limits.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize up to $3 million in general obligation bonds for repairs, upgrades and improvements to Quechee Road (TH-2). The warning estimates the road project’s total cost at $7,444,725; the bond question covers only up to $3 million of that amount.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize up to $3 million in bonds for the described Quechee Road improvements.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize up to $4.2 million in general obligation borrowing to acquire and construct a public works garage, whose estimated cost is $4.2 million. Available state and federal grants would reduce the amount borrowed.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the described borrowing of up to $4.2 million for the public works garage.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorize up to $22 million in additional general obligation bonds or notes for wastewater collection and treatment improvements estimated to cost $54 million. Combined borrowing under this question and the authorization approved March 1, 2022 could not exceed $39.5 million in principal. Grants, subsidies, loan-principal forgiveness, federal ARPA funds, city funds and other available resources must be applied to eligible costs and may reduce the debt issued.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve up to $22 million in additional borrowing, subject to the combined $39.5 million principal cap and the stated use of other funds.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Approve a lease extension for T-Mobile Northeast LLC’s existing space at the city water tower at Main and North Streets. The first five-year extension would start July 23, 2026 at about $4,900 a month, with rent rising 5% each year. Three additional five-year terms would renew automatically unless the tenant declines, ending no later than July 22, 2046. The mayor would execute and record the amendment under the city charter.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the described lease extension, rent increases and renewal terms, and authorize the mayor to execute and record it.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed lease extension authorization.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Give the City Council nonbinding advice on buying the property and improvements at 20 Armory Lane for $1 plus ordinary closing and transaction costs. The proposed municipal and community uses include recreation and youth programming. This advisory vote does not itself authorize a binding property purchase.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Advise the City Council that you support the described acquisition.
measureRecords.noMeans: Advise the City Council that you do not support the described acquisition.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Approve $56,621,592 in school district spending for the next fiscal year. The district estimates $12,503 in per-pupil education spending, 8.95% above the current year.

Authorize sale of the Sunderland Elementary School property at 98 Bear Ridge Road to the buyer named in the official question, or that buyer’s assignee, for $50,000. The sale would have to close by December 31, 2026.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the sale on the stated buyer, price and closing terms.
